name: The Box of Names
tagline: Traces any name across civilizations and eras, marking each link real or legendary
description: Give it a word, a place, a deity, an object, any name at all, and it follows that name across civilizations and centuries, showing how it traveled and morphed between cultures. Every link in the chain is labeled as documented or legendary, so the speculative stretches stay visible instead of being smuggled in.
